model_family_contract.catalog_value: release-risk for kep-m09-a through kep-m09-g; artifact-defined for kep-m09-h through kep-m09-l
model_family_contract.enforcement: derive the concrete family from each accepted artifact and require an authoritative allowed value

kep-m09-a.input: exact signed visible evaluation plus required Forgejo release-image Actions run

kep-m09-b.input: one accepted fixed signed integrity checkpoint from kep-m07-e, kep-m07-g, or kep-m07-i, selected as the exact candidate, plus exact MLflow/Forgejo/model/held-out identities and immutable review image

kep-m09-c.input: accepted frozen candidate and protected approved-lineage commit

kep-m09-d.input: exact candidate/report issue and human release-engineer event

kep-m09-e.input: signed evaluation and exact moved Harbor compatibility label

kep-m09-f.input: exact lineage, approval, image-binding, model, and image digests
kep-m09-f.carrier: v2 signed release binding the complete authoritative release-state identity with one-use promotion authorization

kep-m09-g.input: server-issued one-use capability for the accepted signed release, established Assistant model identities
kep-m09-g.carrier: v2 production runtime inventory with consumed capability and source-visible projected-identity activation callback sender

kep-m09-h.input: fixed signed Cinder model-package handoff and exact participant publication

kep-m09-i.input: bounded Cinder Forgejo artifact URL, exact digest, and optional artifact-declared model family
kep-m09-i.carrier: v2 corrupt-import result carrying the artifact-declared concrete family

kep-m09-k.input: exact human Forgejo close/label event for the mirrored subject

kep-m09-l.input: trusted staging tag plus exact staging-image Actions run and source commit

negative_control: keplerops.operation-denial/v2 records bind operation, distinct attempt, identical immutable subject, and rejected outcome
